residual_nonempty_rule: V_k remains nonempty only until physical vehicle k has served its first bin; already-used vehicles may be empty later

computation_accounting.planning_runtime_s: oracle preparation plus solver wall time
computation_accounting.latency_adjusted_time_s: equal to operating makespan; planning is asynchronous
computation_accounting.compute_wait_aux_energy_kwh: zero; vehicles do not stop while the controller computes

execution_clock: vehicles advance continuously on fixed traffic steps; active edges and services persist across step boundaries
replanning_projection: unavoidable active-edge or active-service work is projected to its downstream decision state for route optimization, while physical execution itself is never teleported
